title: Token accounting for assembled context cards
summary: You cannot optimise accuracy per token without counting tokens; nothing currently does.
description:
Add token counting to `get_context_card()` via an injected `TokenCounter` protocol (default: a character-ratio estimate, so the SDK acquires no tokenizer dependency and the dependency-light install path survives). Return the assembled token count and a per-section breakdown alongside the card.

Unglamorous and load-bearing: ASMB-2's packing has no budget without it, ASMB-6's metric has no denominator, and every claim in EPIC-29 about accuracy per token is currently unverifiable.

Acceptance: token counts returned with every card; the default estimator's error against a real tokenizer is measured and documented so callers know how much slack to leave; an exact counter is injectable; counting overhead is within noise. Blocks ASMB-2 and ASMB-6.
